/*Ammo Finder Bricks you create also spawn a copy for your allies.

Ammo Bricks spawned this way grant ?% [?%] of a Regular Ammo Brick's Pickup Amount.*/

#type Ammo Finder Bricks you create also spawn a copy for your allies.

Ammo Bricks spawned this way grant ?%|?% of a Regular Ammo Brick's Pickup Amount with 1|2 Mods equipped.

var type = Heavy

#type Ammo Finder Bricks you create also spawn a copy for your allies.

Ammo Bricks spawned this way grant 27.5%|60% of a Regular Ammo Brick's Pickup Amount with 1|2 Mods equipped.

var type = Heavy
Heavy Ammo bricks spawned from your ammo meter now appear for allies as well. These bricks contain 37%|67%|100% of the ammo a regular brick would have at 1|2|3 copies of the mod.
